# Focused entry point: Stored villain boosts

The maintained implementation guidance is in [Stored villain boosts](../marvel-champions-content-authoring/SKILL.md#stored-villain-boosts). Use it for facedown cards assigned to a later Villain activation; `EFFECT_DEAL_BOOST` remains for the activation currently resolving.
